{{recipesummary|category=Breakfast recipes|servings=1|time=15 minutes|difficulty=2}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:North American cuisines|North America]] | [[Cookbook:Breakfast|Breakfast cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Cheese|Cheese]] | [[Cookbook:Eggs|Eggs]]

== Ingredients ==
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Tomato Sauce|tomato sauce]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]], [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]], and other seasonings to taste (see tips below)
* [[Cookbook:Cooking Spray|Cooking spray]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|green bell peppers]]
* 2 tablespoons chopped [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushrooms]]
* ¼ cup shredded [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella cheese]]

== Procedure ==
# Mix spices and tomato sauce and allow to meld flavors while preparing the rest of the recipe.
# [[Cookbook:Beat|Beat]] eggs well.
# Heat a small [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] over low heat, sprayed with cooking spray.
# Pour beaten eggs into skillet, then cover skillet.
# Cook for 3 minutes. Eggs should be almost set.
# Carefully flip omelet over. Cook another minute.
# Combine mushrooms and peppers and cook 30 seconds in [[Cookbook:Microwave Oven|microwave oven]]. 
# Spread tomato-spice mix over omelet. Sprinkle cheese over tomato sauce. Top cheese with hot mushrooms and peppers.
# Cover skillet. Cook another 2 minutes. Cheese should be melted.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* [[Cookbook:Basil|Basil]], crushed [[Cookbook:Red Pepper|red pepper]], and [[Cookbook:Oregano|oregano]] work well.
